How to redeem Where Winds Meet codes

  1. Reach level 5. Codes can't be redeemed before then.
  2. Open Settings from the game menu (the cog icon on the right side of the screen).
  3. Go to the "Other" tab and select "Exchange Code".
  4. Paste a code from this list and confirm it.
  5. Collect the rewards from your in-game mail.

iPhone and iPad tip: to stop the game asking to "Allow Paste" every time, open iOS Settings, find Where Winds Meet, and set Paste from Other Apps to Allow.

Redeem errors explained

When a code doesn't work, the game usually shows one of these four messages. If you play in another language, switch the site to it so the messages match.

Already used Redeem Code of the same type.
Your account already redeemed this code. It still works for other players, so don't report it.
Operated too frequently. Please try again later.
The game has a 3-second cooldown between redeem attempts. Wait 3 seconds and try again. Nothing is wrong with the code.
Redeem code has expired.
The code no longer works for anyone. Mark it used, then report it with the "Mark expired" button so it can be verified and moved to the "Confirmed expired" list.
Attempts used up.
The code has run out of redemptions and no longer works. Report it the same way as an expired code.

WWM codes FAQ

Where do Where Winds Meet codes come from?
Official public codes are released for version updates, events and promotions. On top of those, hundreds of codes are given to content creators during each monthly patch cycle. Community members submit them here, and every code is verified before it's added to the list.
How often is this list updated?
As soon as a new code is submitted and verified. Codes confirmed as expired move to the "Confirmed expired" list, so the active list stays current.
Can I redeem a code on more than one character?
No. Each code can be redeemed once per account, even if the account has several characters.
Why doesn't a code work?
Check which error the game showed (see Redeem errors explained). Only the expired and attempts-used-up errors mean the code is dead. Report those so other players know.
How do I keep track of the codes I used?
Copying a code marks it as used. Sign in with Discord to keep your progress on every device.
